verdict.rationale: Maintenance activity is a fair axis for this kind of product, but the evidence pack does not show it. There is no release history or changelog, no public issue tracker or triage activity, and no record of accepted community contributions. The only adjacent signals are a pinned CLI version (0.4.1), integer-versioned process guides, and a single vendor-side worker fix deployed a day after a broken command was recorded. None of these show an actively maintained, community-engaged collection.
